title: Female employees join chain hunger strike at GMC Rajouri over pending recruitment rules

ai.summary: Female employees of five new Jammu and Kashmir Government Medical Colleges joined a chain hunger strike for 12 days after seven years of pending recruitment rules, demanding notification of service rules.

facts.claim: Female employees of GMC Rajouri joined a chain hunger strike with their children
facts.quote: female employees of GMC Rajouri joining a chain hunger strike along with their children

facts.claim: Employees are protesting delay in notifying service recruitment rules for seven years
facts.quote: delay in notifying their service recruitment rules, which they said have remained pending for the past seven years

facts.claim: Strike observed across five GMCs in Rajouri, Udhampur, Kathua, Anantnag and Handwara
facts.quote: strike is being observed across all five new GMCs in Rajouri, Udhampur, Kathua, Anantnag and Handwara

facts.claim: Chief Secretary Dr Sajjan Singh Yadav assured notification within next month
facts.quote: Chief Secretary Dr Sajjan Singh Yadav meeting the protesting employees at GMC Rajouri two days ago and assuring them that the recruitment rules would be notified within the next month

facts.claim: Employees shifted to chain hunger strike with two employees sitting daily
facts.quote: the employees have now shifted to a chain hunger strike, with two employees sitting on hunger strike every day

ai.background_note: Female employees of five new Jammu and Kashmir Government Medical Colleges have been protesting for seven years over pending service recruitment rules, escalating to a chain hunger strike after 12 days of agitation.
